name: How much does an outdoor kitchen cost in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What does a built-in outdoor kitchen cost in Los Angeles versus a basic grill area?
mainEntity.text: What does a built-in outdoor kitchen cost in Los Angeles versus a basic grill area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Outdoor kitchen pricing in Los Angeles varies widely based on complexity. A simple built-in grill island is far less expensive than a full cooking area with stone finishes, refrigeration, sink plumbing, gas hookups, task lighting, and a covered structure. Design choices like custom cabinetry, premium counters, and integrated shade also raise costs quickly. The biggest budget drivers are usually utility work, site access, structural additions, and appliance selection. Homeowners should plan for both the visible finishes and the hidden infrastructure, since plumbing and electrical rough-in can significantly change the total price. If the project is part of a larger backyard remodel, bundling the work into one coordinated build often produces better results than adding pieces in phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: A basic built-in grill setup can start around the mid-five-figure range, while fully integrated outdoor kitchens with gas, water, refrigeration, and a roofed area often cost much more. Final cost depends on appliances, finishes, and utilities.
